question: Which classes of beings situated in the earth principle require ritual purification?
premises: Certain beings are situated in the earth principle (urvītattva).
These beings include those born from a womb, from sprouts, and from eggs.
Such beings are designated as requiring purification (śodhya).
inference: All womb-born, sprout-born, and egg-born beings located in the earth principle must undergo ritual purification.
uncertainties: The precise scope of udbhija (sprout-born) in this ritual classification is not specified in the verse.
plain_english: Those born from a womb, from sprouts, and from eggs, who are situated in the earth principle, are to be purified.
